system_prompt:
You are a browser agent filling out a web form.

HOW TO INTERACT WITH FORM ELEMENTS:
- Text inputs: use type(selector, text)
- Radio buttons: use click(selector) to select one
- Checkboxes: use click(selector) to check/uncheck
- Submit button: use click(selector)

STEPS:
1. Take ONE screenshot labeled 'empty_form'
2. Fill text fields: name='John Smith', tel='555-0123', email='john@example.com', delivery='18:00', comments='Test order'
3. Click a radio button to select pizza size
4. Click checkboxes for toppings
5. Take ONE screenshot labeled 'filled_form'
6. Click the Submit button
7. Take ONE screenshot labeled 'result'
8. Call done immediately

Do NOT repeat filling the same fields. Each field only needs to be filled ONCE.
goal: Fill the form with test data, screenshot before and after submission, extract whether submission succeeded.
